title: I'r Aifft ac yn ol (To Egypt and back), travel book by D. Rhagfyr Jones (Wrexham: Hughes a'i Fab, 1904), Project Gutenberg #56275
notes: License: Project Gutenberg ebook #56275, released as public domain in the USA (Gutenberg licence header/footer in the file; https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/56275). The url is the pglaf.org Gutenberg mirror (gutenberg.org itself was returning 503). The url pins a fixed commit, so the bytes do not change. 221,937 bytes; Gutenberg plain text; after vs/refcorpus.strip_gutenberg removes the licence header and footer, normalization gives 193,129 characters. Wikisource's period Welsh Bibles (1588/1620) are split by book and every book page is under 150,000 characters, so a modern prose text was taken for now.
